name: kai
description: Kai — Hanzo's unified decision model and verified action engine. One tool for calibrated decisions (/v1/decisions: decide, choice, score, noul), verified zero-LLM repository actions (run, plan, list, triggers), typed context compaction (compact), deterministic tool & candidate ranking (tool_select, next_action), pre-execution command policy (command_guard), prompt-injection screening (injection_screen), structured field extraction (extract), build/CI failure classification & loop-breaking recovery (log_triage, recover), and single-pass trajectory steps (agent_step).

action.description: Kai operation: decide | choice | score | noul | run | plan | list | triggers | compact | tool_select | next_action | command_guard | injection_screen | extract | log_triage | recover | agent_step

state.description: The case to decide about (decide, choice, score, noul, next_action)

questions.description: decide: Question name -> {type: choice|score|noul, instructions?, criteria?}; 1 to 100 questions

instructions.description: choice / score / noul: What Kai answers

criteria.description: choice: {label: desc} or [label, ...]; score: [level0, level1, ...]; noul: {"true": ..., "false": ...}

request.description: run / plan / triggers: The chore in the user's words

cwd.description: run / plan: Working directory (default: server cwd)

approve.description: run / plan: Grant approval for consequential actions (push, remote, outside workspace, stop process)

ask.description: run / plan: Ask Kai when several actions or values remain (default true)

cache.description: run / plan: Directory for action proofs and reusable memos

prove.description: run / plan: Record a proof for each action whose verifier passes

min_margin.description: run / plan: Least lead of Kai's pick over the next real option (default 0.1)

min_p.description: run / plan: Least probability of Kai's pick among real options (default 0)

max_abstain.description: run / plan: Most probability Kai may give to abstaining (default 0.6)

preserve_recent.description: compact: Number of recent messages to keep verbatim (default 4)

keep_threshold.description: compact: Confidence threshold for keeping tool outputs (default 0.5)

truncate_chars.description: compact: Max characters retained for truncated outputs (default 400)

task.description: tool_select: What the agent is about to do

limit.description: tool_select: Maximum ranked tools to return (default 5)

candidates.description: next_action: Candidate actions [{action_id, tool, description, parameters?, preconditions_satisfied?}]

command.description: command_guard: Shell command line to classify (allow | ask | deny)

text.description: injection_screen / extract: Untrusted text or evidence object

schema.description: extract: Field extraction schema {field: {type: choice|score|noul, description?, options?, levels?}}

logs.description: log_triage: Build, test, or CI log tail

trajectory.description: agent_step: Prior steps [{step_index, action, tool_name, arguments, observation, is_error}]

available_tools.description: agent_step: Candidate tool specifications [{name, description, parameters}]
